terra.problem: The line and first moment title place Havilah near Eden, but Genesis does not say how close it was. The Pishon flowed from the river out of Eden, but its course and the location of Havilah are uncertain.
The line presents all three references as the same region, but the sources say it is uncertain whether the Havilah of Genesis 2 is the same as the Havilah in the later passages.
